title.narrative: Advance Consulting led Work Package 4 to strengthen market development for hybrid and improved vegetable seed by improving the evidence available on distribution systems and promotion strategies.

description.narrative: Advance Consulting led Work Package 4 to strengthen market development for hybrid and improved vegetable seed by improving the evidence available on distribution systems and promotion strategies. Two studies were undertaken during Year 1. The first, 'Demand, Distribution and Supply in Ghana's Vegetable Seed System: A Farmer, Dealer and Importer Survey', examined the structure, performance and bottlenecks of Ghana's vegetable seed distribution network. The second assessed the feasibility of a Dutch-branded social-media campaign to increase farmer awareness and adoption of quality seed. The research included interviews with 400 farmers and 50 agro-input retail shops, alongside consultations with major vegetable seed importers and distributors. Participatory Development Associates, a Ghanaian research firm, facilitated field data collection. Findings were shared with EKN and project partners, and the vegetable seed-system study has been published online.
